title: Appraisal Order Update Visit Scope Rule
content:
# Visit scope of an Appraisal Order update visit

The visit-scope rule of the update visit charge reads the order's completion flag and its reinspection charges:

1. an order whose value is subject to completion is updated and certified complete in one combined visit, charged the standard update charge plus 60 percent of the report type's reinspection fee;
2. an order whose value is not subject to completion and which carries a reinspection charge dated within the last 2 calendar months is recertified from that recent visit at a flat 175 dollars, in place of the standard update charge;
3. any other order is charged the standard update charge.

The update visit charge stacks its parts on the report type's reinspection fee and is then set by its visit-scope rule; the complexity add-on and the final inspection charge stack their own parts under their own rules, and every other appraisal charge is still charged at its own amount with no stacking or discount. The standard update charge here is the update charge as built for the visit, before this rule. The 60 percent of the reinspection fee is kept to the cent. A reinspection charge is a charge entry on the order's reinspection line; it is "within the last 2 calendar months" when its entry date falls within the 2 calendar months up to today.

| Value subject to completion | Reinspection charge dated within the last 2 calendar months | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Standard update charge plus 60 percent of the reinspection fee |
| No | Yes | 175.00 flat |
| No | No | Standard update charge |

**60 percent of the reinspection fee, by report type (US dollars).**

| Report type | Reinspection fee | 60 percent |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | 150.00 | 90.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | 150.00 | 90.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | 175.00 | 105.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | 175.00 | 105.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | 200.00 | 120.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | 225.00 | 135.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | 250.00 | 150.00 |

*Hypothetical:* a Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) order with a standard update charge of 400.00 and a value subject to completion is charged 400.00 plus 105.00, that is 505.00. The same order with a value not subject to completion and a reinspection charge dated three weeks ago is charged 175.00; with its only reinspection charge dated five months ago, 400.00.
